scenario: Two walkable floors with identical XY
required: Bodies, paths, pickup and exit targets retain the correct support; no contact/separation through the slab.

scenario: Open stairwell beside a closed slab
required: Sight/light can cross the opening and cannot cross the closed slab. Horizontal, vertical and oblique rays agree on the same primitives.
Continuous Z/velocity, correct support normals and physical path distance; no acceleration/stamina changes on the flat control.
Finite-time step-up, no pose teleport, actual riser/ceiling collision; item/corpse motion does not use assisted steps.
Current pose remains continuous; correct support or free fall; traversal cannot finish after interruption by writing its endpoint.

scenario: Thin intermediate slab during fast fall
required: Sweep lands on first intersected support; cannot tunnel through or select a higher floor behind the trajectory.
Head/body hits underside; no ceiling escape or automatic promotion to upper-floor support.

scenario: Crawl passage under an occupied upper floor
required: Low posture fits; standing rejected; upper actor neither blocks the crawl through an intact slab nor becomes touchable.

scenario: Narrow seam, convex corner and near-equal contacts
required: Stable support/tie order, bounded penetration, no tiny-step wall exploit and no frame-rate-dependent floor jitter.
Real Hound crawl/vault remains possible where valid; Smiler gains no crawl/tight-gap/teleport ability.

scenario: A* with stacked endpoints and one-way drop
required: Finds connected route; rejects impossible reverse; no XY-only snap/cache reuse/shortcut across an unsupported gap.

scenario: Target visible, then hides and chooses different floors
required: With identical legitimate observations, decisions/RNG match until new evidence differs. Hidden true support/Z cannot select the branch.
Anonymous identity and vertical uncertainty preserved; no source-ID or true-floor leak. Door/stairwell and slab attenuation differ only by geometry/material.
Z-aware occlusion and receiver height; visible-light rules retained; IR OFF/HIGH produces identical monster decisions under otherwise identical observations.

scenario: Gaze through a floor versus through a clear opening
required: Physical LOS required; existing Hound intimidation and Smiler hold/release timers remain unchanged when observations are equal.
No impossible physical grouping/contact; no new shared hidden-player knowledge; flat group/watchdog traces remain unchanged.
Fall/traversal continues at fixed ticks; no sleep in midair, link teleport or skipped landing because an observer leaves.
Real motor and recovery threshold 36/radius 15 verified; equal 15/30/60/120/144/240/360 FPS and jitter schedules produce equal fixed-tick results.
Actual movement state machine drives geometry; no replacement formula model; valid modes retain their resource costs and finite trajectories.
Seeded 20–250 ms latency, jitter, duplicated/stale reports and a 1 s bunching interruption; no unauthorized movement, persistent rejection or lifecycle reset; record correction count and magnitude.
Reject huge XY/Z jumps, wrong support, fake link completion, future/reused tick credit, speed/quiet-gait claims, nonfinite values and geometry mismatch.
Old `h1` near x=5000/server time 60; new `h1` near x=1000/time 1 and another support. Use new pose immediately; old clock/slots/Z history removed. Jitter does not reset the world.
No interpolation through a slab; same continuous trajectory at different render FPS; teleports do not blend; unknown extrapolated edges hold.

scenario: Alive/free, captured, dead, revived and new-run lifecycle
required: Existing respawn/join restrictions, one-use revive and authorization persist; no stamina/protection/teleport escape through new spatial fields.

scenario: All eight existing death variants on spatial fixtures
required: Continuous body and independent hands, actual wall impacts, gear detachment/landing, support-aware friction and no sleeping while airborne.
Other client receives replay, one physical aftermath/corpse, equipment included; late join during fall and after sleep sees the same object state.

scenario: Normal client replay then delayed/duplicate messages
required: Server does not duplicate or replace correct physical aftermath with stale client pose; death/life generations separate successive deaths.

scenario: Body on ledge, gear falling to lower floor
required: Mass loses support appropriately; hands cannot brace in air; gear has independent support/beam; decal remains on its actual contact face.
Independent cutaway, same authoritative state/hash; unseen geometry and effects remain masked; one client's camera changes no other client's view.

scenario: High resolution, ultrawide, NV/zoom and overlays
required: Canonical awareness footprint preserved; no hidden entities/eyes/blood/replays/gear leaking from separate Canvas/Pixi layers.

scenario: No live players, active settling bodies
required: Physics continues until valid sleep or explicit room disposal; no freeze caused by the current live-player early return.

scenario: Fresh extraction in a path containing spaces
required: Advertised tests/build scripts run without original machine paths; generated outputs reproduce; all required runtime modules return HTTP 200.
